metadata.description: ATR (Agentic Test Runner) Claude Code skills and MCP server for browser automation

plugins.name: atr-skills
plugins.description: Skills: browser control + recording (atr-browser), run tests with AI analysis (atr-analyze - keeps context clean), behavior testing (atr-behavior). MCP Server: 30 browser tools (navigate, click, fill, screenshot, eval, computed-styles, wait, scroll, text, viewport, etc.) via 'atr mcp serve'
